updates.description: Choose a profile picture that stays readable inside a small circle: folded paper framing in A Fold Around You, illustrated shoulder movement in A Small Burst of Motion, a soft studio portrait or a clean everyday profile. Start with a clear reference face, keep the full hairline and chin inside the crop, and compare the result at thumbnail size before using it.
